name: Create segment
description: Call this when you need to create a new contact segment based on a filter query. Use the update segment action instead if the segment already exists and only its definition needs to change.

name.description: The display name of the segment.

fe_query.description: The filter query defining which contacts belong to the segment. The exact structure follows Brevo's internal query format.

category_id.description: Identifier of the category under which the segment should be stored.

source.description: Origin of the segment creation request, e.g., "listing".

id.description: Unique identifier of the newly created segment.

side_effects: A new segment is added to the account and can be used for targeting contacts.
